flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi CasIntegrationController.casUpdateCourtNotices (CAS source, not credited); ocmsadminprivateapi resources/sftp/sftp-common.properties (no State Courts folder); ocmsadminui Icourtmention.d.ts (type only).
note: Requirement status is not given / blank; traced normally. There is no inbound channel from State Courts (SFTP folder, endpoint or webhook) and no code processing an application outcome. case_appl_status, roms_outcome and case_status_recd_date are only types in ocmsadminui. CasIntegrationController.casUpdateCourtNotices receives updates from CAS (not State Courts) and writes ocms_court_case/VON; it is not credited because its source and content differ from a State Courts application outcome.
recommendation: Do not claim. Receiving and processing State Courts outcomes does not exist; the CAS endpoint is not equivalent.
